corpus_provenance: Original synthetic fixtures generated by make_pdf_benchmark_corpus.py; authored expected structure, not independent annotations of scientific papers.
resources: separate bounded process tree per document/backend; GROBID service memory is excluded

metric_definitions.table_positional_cell_recall: exact normalized text at the correct table/page/row/column divided by annotated cells; never just bag-of-text
metric_definitions.page_text_locator_recall: fraction of authored expected spans found on the expected page
metric_definitions.mean_bbox_iou: mean rectangle intersection-over-union for exact authored text/page matches; unavailable for backends without comparable boxes
